requirements.evidence: This is an evidence-only directory. No SDK package, wheel, extracted archive or clean-install fixture is built or installed.
requirements.requirement: Verify a clean checkout or extracted package.

requirements.evidence: A synthetic request/result envelope exercises the documented adapter CLI shape (--request/--result, offline mode, caller-owned bytes, identity output, replay, reset and idempotent close). It does not import or execute torch or SpeechBrain.
The synthetic envelope copies and validates caller-supplied float32 bytes, rejects a digest or byte-count mismatch, and never searches the filesystem or downloads an asset.
Strict JSON, manifest and envelope rejection matrices fail closed on malformed, missing, extra, duplicate, aliased, nonfinite and out-of-range inputs without advancing state.
Missing runtime, network, download, mode and asset selections are explicit rejections; no optional value is defaulted into an admissible run.
No build, link, CMake target, native runtime or packaging step is attempted or claimed.
No synthetic *runtime* exists: the envelope proves protocol plumbing only. No tensor operation, model forward, checkpoint load or runtime import occurs.
No measured workload, host/device timing, resource, listening or benchmark result is produced. Historical RTF/RSS values are provenance only.
